D: Three silent film stars mistake a real call for help from a Mexican village for a paid show.
P: Serve the mains at El Guapo's birthday party.
S: the cantina where they start a brawl

Corn chips layered with spiced black beans and melted cheddar, topped with pico de gallo, pickled jalapeno, guacamole and sour cream. Warm a drained tin of black beans with 1 tsp cumin and a splash of water and mash roughly. Layer 300g corn chips, the beans and 200g grated cheddar on a tray and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Dice 3 tomatoes, half a red onion and coriander with lime and salt for pico. Mash 2 avocados with lime. Top the nachos with pico, sliced pickled jalapeno, guacamole and 150g sour cream.
Charred corn with lime mayo, crumbled feta, chilli powder and coriander
Corn cobs grilled until charred, rolled in mayo and lime, covered in crumbled feta, chilli powder and coriander.
Charred tomatillo and green chilli salsa with warm corn chips
Green salsa: tomatillos and green chillies charred, blitzed with onion, garlic, coriander and lime, served with warm tortilla chips.
M: Slow roast achiote pork shredded into corn tortillas, lime pickled onion
Pork shoulder marinated in achiote, orange and garlic, roasted wrapped at 160C for 4 hours, shredded, in corn tortillas with pickled red onion and habanero salsa.

Poached chicken and cheese rolled in corn tortillas, smothered in a smoky red chilli sauce and more cheese, baked bubbling, with sour cream and coriander. Poach 800g chicken thighs in salted water for 20 minutes and shred. Soften a diced onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 chipotle in adobo, 700g passata and 200ml stock and simmer 15 minutes. Mix the chicken with a little sauce and 100g cheese. Roll in 12 corn tortillas, lay in a dish, cover with sauce and 150g cheese and bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Top with sour cream and coriander.
W: Fried cinnamon sugar churros with dulce de leche for dipping
Choux dough piped into hot oil at 180C, fried golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar, with dulce de leche for dipping and a candle in the pile.
K: Tequila, orange liqueur and lime shaken and strained into a salt rimmed glass

45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime shaken with ice, salt rim. For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime juice with ice. Strain into a glass with a salted rim. Makes four plethoras of margaritas.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the lime mayonnaise and crumble the feta up to 1 day ahead, chilled; grill the corn and assemble just before serving

steps.text: Grill the corn on a hot barbecue or grill pan, turning, until charred in spots.
Mix the mayonnaise with the lime juice and crumble the feta.
Brush the cobs with the mayonnaise, roll in feta and dust with chilli powder and chopped coriander.
Char the tomatillos and chillies under a hot grill until blistered.
Blitz with the onion, garlic, coriander and lime juice until chunky. Season to taste.
Serve with warm corn chips.

dishes.make_ahead: Pork can be cooked 1 day ahead

steps.text: Rub the pork with the achiote paste, orange juice and crushed garlic and marinate in the fridge overnight, or at least an hour if short on time.
Wrap the pork tightly in foil and roast at 160C until falling apart.
Slice the red onion thin and quick-pickle in lime juice with a pinch of salt.
Shred the pork in its juices and warm the tortillas.
Serve in tortillas with the pickled onion and habanero salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Jackfruit can be cooked 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: tins young green jackfruit in brine (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Pull the jackfruit into shreds and mix with the achiote paste, orange juice, crushed garlic and oil.
Wrap tightly in foil and roast at 180C until tender.
Slice the red onion thin and quick-pickle in lime juice with a pinch of salt.
Unwrap, roast 20 minutes more until crisp at the edges, then warm the tortillas.
Serve in tortillas with the pickled onion and habanero salsa.
Boil the water and butter, tip in the flour and beat to a smooth ball. Cool slightly, then beat in the eggs.
Pipe the dough with a star nozzle into 180C oil and fry until golden, turning once.
Toss in the sugar and cinnamon while hot.
Serve with dulce de leche for dipping and a candle in the pile.

dishes.make_ahead: Juice the limes up to 1 day ahead, chilled; shake the drinks to order

steps.text: Juice the limes and rim four glasses with a lime wedge and salt.
Shake the tequila, orange liqueur and lime juice with ice in batches, one drink at a time.
Strain into the glasses over fresh ice.

af.make_ahead: Juice the limes and mix the lime juice, orange juice and agave up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; shake with ice to order and top with soda water

steps.text: Juice the limes and rim four glasses with a lime wedge and salt.
Shake the lime juice, orange juice and agave syrup with ice in batches, one drink at a time.
Strain into the glasses over fresh ice and top with a splash of soda water.

s.note: Charred corn with lime mayo, crumbled feta, chilli powder and coriander
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs until charred. Brush with 4 tbsp mayo mixed with lime juice. Roll in 100g crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder and chopped coriander.

s.note: Charred tomatillo and green chilli salsa with warm corn chips
s.how: Char 400g tomatillos and 2 green chillies under the grill. Blitz with half an onion, a garlic clove, coriander and lime juice until chunky. Serve with warm corn chips.

m.note: Slow roast achiote pork shredded into corn tortillas, lime pickled onion
m.how: Marinate 1.2kg pork shoulder in 50g achiote paste, the juice of 2 oranges and 3 garlic cloves overnight. Wrap and roast at 160C for 4 hours, then shred. Quick-pickle a red onion in lime. Serve in 16 corn tortillas with habanero salsa.

w.note: Fried cinnamon sugar churros with dulce de leche for dipping
w.how: Boil 250ml water with 60g butter, beat in 150g flour, then 2 eggs. Pipe into 180C oil and fry until golden. Toss in 100g sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve with dulce de leche for dipping and a candle in the pile.

d.note: Tequila, orange liqueur and lime shaken and strained into a salt rimmed glass
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime juice with ice. Strain into a glass with a salted rim. Makes four plethoras of margaritas.
